name: insuremo-dsh-desktop
description: InsureMO DSH Desktop shell and runtime controller.

scripts.build: electron-vite build && node scripts/copy-runtime-assets.mjs && node scripts/gen-icon.mjs
scripts.package:e08:win: pnpm build && pnpm build:e08:supervisor && pnpm build:e08:resources && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:e08:win:signed: pnpm build && pnpm build:e08:supervisor && pnpm build:e08:resources && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:e07:arm64:dir: pnpm build && DSH_RUNTIME_ARCH=arm64 pnpm build:e07:resources && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --dir --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:e07:arm64:signed-dir: pnpm build && DSH_RUNTIME_ARCH=arm64 pnpm build:e07:resources && electron-builder --dir --arm64 --publish never && node scripts/finalize-e07-signature.mjs "release/mac-arm64/InsureMO DSH Desktop.app"
scripts.package:e07:arm64:mac: pnpm build && DSH_RUNTIME_ARCH=arm64 pnpm build:e07:resources && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac zip dmg --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:e07:x64:dir: pnpm build && DSH_RUNTIME_ARCH=x64 pnpm build:e07:resources && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --dir --x64 --publish never
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm check:lines && pnpm check:e00
